answer.summary: API Types Check fails because the generated TypeScript types differ from the committed ones. The diff adds asset_stale, asset_stale_since, asset_last_seen and asset_last_seen_source, which come from this PR's asset freshness change, and the step reports that types were not regenerated before committing. A rerun on the same commit will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
